verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Workspace has REST API reference documentation for the Admin SDK Directory and Reports APIs, but nothing says a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent) can be downloaded. Probes of the standard OpenAPI paths on developers.google.com all returned 404. Human-readable REST reference pages are an adjacent artifact, not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
